SELECT id, code, name, priority, remark, active, created_at, updated_at FROM retail_price_sources ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, code, name, priority, remark, active, created_at, updated_at FROM retail_price_sources WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, code, name, priority, remark, active, created_at, updated_at FROM retail_price_sources WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO retail_price_sources (code, name, priority, remark, active) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{priority}, #{remark}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE retail_price_sources SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, priority = #{priority}, remark = #{remark}, active = #{active}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
